description: This file defines the 'Chart' class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, which encapsulates properties and behaviors for Excel chart objects, including positioning, axes, labels, styling, and rendering.

classes.name: Chart
classes.description: Represents a chart object in a spreadsheet, handling properties such as title, legend, axes, plot area, position, and rendering functionalities within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the chart.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the chart.

methods.name: getWorksheet
methods.description: Retrieves the worksheet associated with the chart.

methods.name: setWorksheet
methods.description: Associates a worksheet with the chart.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Gets the chart's title object.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the chart's title.

methods.name: getLegend
methods.description: Retrieves the legend object of the chart.

methods.name: setLegend
methods.description: Sets the legend object for the chart.

methods.name: getXAxisLabel
methods.description: Gets the X-axis label object.

methods.name: setXAxisLabel
methods.description: Sets the X-axis label.

methods.name: getYAxisLabel
methods.description: Gets the Y-axis label object.

methods.name: setYAxisLabel
methods.description: Sets the Y-axis label.

methods.name: getPlotArea
methods.description: Retrieves the plot area object.

methods.name: setPlotArea
methods.description: Sets the plot area for the chart.

methods.name: getPlotVisibleOnly
methods.description: Returns whether only visible data series are plotted.

methods.name: setPlotVisibleOnly
methods.description: Configures whether to plot only visible data series.

methods.name: getDisplayBlanksAs
methods.description: Gets the display mode for blank data points.

methods.name: setDisplayBlanksAs
methods.description: Sets how blank data points are displayed.

methods.name: getChartAxisY
methods.description: Returns the Y-axis object.

methods.name: setChartAxisY
methods.description: Sets the Y-axis object.

methods.name: getChartAxisX
methods.description: Returns the X-axis object.

methods.name: setChartAxisX
methods.description: Sets the X-axis object.

methods.name: setTopLeftPosition
methods.description: Positions the top-left corner of the chart by cell reference and optional offsets.

methods.name: getTopLeftPosition
methods.description: Retrieves the position of the top-left corner of the chart.

methods.name: getTopLeftCell
methods.description: Returns the cell reference for the top-left position of the chart.

methods.name: setTopLeftCell
methods.description: Sets the cell reference for the top-left position.

methods.name: setTopLeftOffset
methods.description: Sets the offset within the top-left cell.

methods.name: getTopLeftOffset
methods.description: Gets the current offset within the top-left cell.

methods.name: setTopLeftXOffset
methods.description: Sets the X-offset within the top-left cell.

methods.name: getTopLeftXOffset
methods.description: Gets the X-offset within the top-left cell.

methods.name: setTopLeftYOffset
methods.description: Sets the Y-offset within the top-left cell.

methods.name: getTopLeftYOffset
methods.description: Gets the Y-offset within the top-left cell.

methods.name: setBottomRightPosition
methods.description: Positions the bottom-right corner of the chart with cell reference and optional offsets.

methods.name: getBottomRightPosition
methods.description: Retrieves the position information of the bottom-right corner.

methods.name: setBottomRightCell
methods.description: Sets the cell reference for the bottom-right corner of the chart.

methods.name: getBottomRightCell
methods.description: Gets the cell reference of the bottom-right corner.

methods.name: setBottomRightOffset
methods.description: Sets the offset within the bottom-right cell.

methods.name: getBottomRightOffset
methods.description: Retrieves the offset within the bottom-right cell.

methods.name: setBottomRightXOffset
methods.description: Sets the X-offset for the bottom-right position.

methods.name: getBottomRightXOffset
methods.description: Gets the X-offset for the bottom-right position.

methods.name: setBottomRightYOffset
methods.description: Sets the Y-offset for the bottom-right position.

methods.name: getBottomRightYOffset
methods.description: Gets the Y-offset for the bottom-right position.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Updates the plot area if worksheet and plot area are set.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the chart to a specified destination, using a chart renderer defined in Settings.

methods.name: getRotX
methods.description: Gets the rotation angle around X axis.

methods.name: setRotX
methods.description: Sets the rotation angle around X axis.

methods.name: getRotY
methods.description: Gets the rotation angle around Y axis.

methods.name: setRotY
methods.description: Sets the rotation angle around Y axis.

methods.name: getRAngAx
methods.description: Gets the R angle of the axis.

methods.name: setRAngAx
methods.description: Sets the R angle of the axis.

methods.name: getPerspective
methods.description: Gets the perspective value.

methods.name: setPerspective
methods.description: Sets the perspective value.

methods.name: getOneCellAnchor
methods.description: Checks if the chart is anchored to one cell.

methods.name: setOneCellAnchor
methods.description: Sets whether the chart is anchored to one cell.

methods.name: getAutoTitleDeleted
methods.description: Indicates whether the auto-generated title was deleted.

methods.name: setAutoTitleDeleted
methods.description: Sets whether the auto title was deleted.

methods.name: getNoFill
methods.description: Checks if the chart has no fill color.

methods.name: setNoFill
methods.description: Sets whether the chart has no fill color.

methods.name: getRoundedCorners
methods.description: Checks if the chart has rounded corners.

methods.name: setRoundedCorners
methods.description: Sets whether the chart has rounded corners.

methods.name: getBorderLines
methods.description: Returns the border lines object.

methods.name: setBorderLines
methods.description: Sets the border lines object.

methods.name: getFillColor
methods.description: Returns the fill color object.
